custom_logic_notes: The Hans Indicator Cloud System defines multiple horizontal price zones (clouds) based on historical period ranges. Pending buy stop orders are placed above the upper cloud boundary; sell stop orders below the lower cloud boundary. Orders are deleted if price reverses before triggering. The cloud zones recalculate each period, and pending orders are repositioned accordingly. The system closes opposite-side positions when a new signal triggers. Pending order management (place/modify/delete) is central to the logic - orders expire if not triggered within the current period.
python_conversion_notes: The custom Hans_Indicator_Cloud_System indicator must be reimplemented in Python first - it calculates zone boundaries from historical price ranges over configurable periods. The zone logic (cloud direction, boundary levels) must be replicated before the EA logic can be ported. Pending order placement above/below cloud zones requires careful state management. The multifactor money management (conditional fixed vs margin-fraction sizing) needs exact replication. Pay special attention to the pending order lifecycle: place on new bar, modify on recalculation, delete on reversal or period expiry. SL/TP values use digit adjustment (multiply by 10 for 5-digit brokers) - verify _Point scaling in Python.
